features.name: core_junction_ag
features.description: Indicator for the presence of the 'AG' dinucleotide immediately upstream of the putative splice site.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a strong linear margin for identifying valid splice junctions.

features.name: core_junction_gt
features.description: Indicator for the presence of the 'GT' dinucleotide immediately downstream of the putative splice site.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a strong linear margin for identifying valid splice junctions.

features.name: extended_ei_consensus
features.description: Score representing the match to the extended consensus sequence around the junction.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates multiple positional matches into a continuous severity measure suitable for linear models.
features.formula: np.where(attribute_29 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_30 == 'G', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_31 == 'G', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_32 == 'T', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_33 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_34 == 'G', 1.0, 0.0)

features.name: extended_ie_consensus
features.description: Score representing the match to the extended consensus sequence upstream of the junction.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates multiple positional matches into a continuous severity measure suitable for linear models.
features.formula: np.where(attribute_26 == 'C', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_27 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_28 == 'C', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_29 == 'A', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_30 == 'G', 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(attribute_31 == 'G', 1.0, 0.0)
